title: Phytofabrication of Ag/AgCl silver nanoparticles from the extract of Phoenix dactylifera L. Medjool date seeds: synthesis, characterization and antimicrobial properties
content:

Successful phytofabrication of spherical, nanosized, and face-centered cubic (fcc) phase Ag/AgCl nanoparticles from Phoenix dactylifera L. Medjool date seeds, exhibiting potent antibacterial activity against E. coli, P. aeruginosa, and S. aureus.
